meta.cost_accounting: Token usage is read from each chat-completions response (usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens, usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens). Attempts without usage are priced at an upper bound: input = ceil(request bytes / 3) tokens, output = max_completion_tokens. cost_status is measured only when usage is complete and the price is verified, otherwise estimated.
